sources.title: DeepTutor: Open-Source, Multi-agent AI Learning Assistant
sources.snippet: DeepTutor is a free, open-source AI learning assistant for studying course materials, research papers, technical documentation, and other sources you collect. It can answer questions grounded in your material, explain difficult passages, and generate practice questions.
